'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Thomas McGee LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas McGee]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Thomas McBee
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
